title: TenderAI tender record
description: Shape a teammate formats a scraped tender into before submitting it with validate_and_submit.py. This is the SAME shape that gets stored in BigQuery's `tenders` table, minus the bookkeeping fields (tender_id, content_hash, first_seen_at, last_scanned_at, updated_at) which are computed by upsert_tender() and must never be set by hand.

source_reference_id.description: The portal's own ID/code for this tender (e.g. an RFx number). Used together with source_id to detect whether this is a new tender or an update to one already stored. If a source has no stable reference ID, leave this null and source_url is used instead.

source_id.description: Which portal this came from, matching a row in the `sources` table (e.g. "vic-buyingfor").

source_url.description: Direct link back to the tender's listing/detail page.

documents.description: Plain-text-extracted attachments. No original file is archived (see schema doc design principles) — extracted_text is the only copy that survives.

document_id.description: Leave null — assigned automatically if omitted.

parsed_at.description: ISO timestamp. Leave null to default to submit time.

raw_extra.description: Catch-all for source-specific fields not modelled above. Keep it JSON-serialisable.
